name: device_id
description: Unique identifier for a mobility device (scooter, bike, moped)

name: provider_id
description: Unique identifier for the mobility service provider

name: provider_name
description: Human-readable name of the mobility service provider

name: vehicle_id
description: Provider-assigned identifier for the vehicle

name: vehicle_type
description: Type of vehicle: bicycle, cargo_bicycle, scooter, moped, car

name: propulsion_types
description: Array of propulsion types: human, electric_assist, electric, combustion

name: year
description: Model year of the vehicle

name: mfgr
description: Manufacturer of the vehicle

name: model
description: Model name of the vehicle

name: status
description: Current availability status of the device (available, reserved, unavailable, removed)

name: prev_status
description: Previous availability status before the current status change

name: reason
description: Reason for the current status (e.g., battery_low, maintenance, compliance)

name: battery_pct
description: Current battery charge level as a percentage (0–100)

name: lat
description: Latitude of the device's current location in WGS84 decimal degrees

name: lng
description: Longitude of the device's current location in WGS84 decimal degrees

name: altitude
description: Altitude of the device in meters above mean sea level

name: speed
description: Current speed of the device in meters per second

name: heading
description: Direction of travel in degrees clockwise from true north (0–360)

name: accuracy
description: Horizontal accuracy of the GPS reading in meters

name: timestamp
description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the data point was recorded

name: trip_id
description: Unique identifier for a trip

name: trip_duration
description: Total duration of the trip in seconds

name: trip_distance
description: Total distance traveled during the trip in meters

name: start_time
description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the trip started

name: end_time
description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the trip ended

name: start_location
description: GeoJSON point representing where the trip started

name: end_location
description: GeoJSON point representing where the trip ended

name: route
description: GeoJSON LineString representing the path taken during the trip

name: parking_verification_url
description: URL to an image verifying correct parking at end of trip

name: standard_cost
description: Total cost of the trip in cents based on standard pricing

name: actual_cost
description: Actual amount charged for the trip in cents after discounts

name: service_area_id
description: Identifier for the geographic service area this data applies to

name: geography_id
description: Identifier for a MDS geography (zone, area, or boundary)

name: geography_type
description: Type of MDS geography (e.g., policy, jurisdiction, no_ride_zone)

name: geography
description: GeoJSON geometry representing the MDS geography boundary

name: policy_id
description: Unique identifier for a MDS policy

name: policy_name
description: Human-readable name of the MDS policy

name: rules
description: Array of rule objects within a MDS policy

name: rule_type
description: Type of policy rule: count, time, speed, user

name: maximum
description: Maximum allowed value under the rule (e.g., max vehicle count in zone)

name: minimum
description: Minimum required value under the rule

name: start_date
description: Date the policy or geography takes effect (Unix ms timestamp)

name: end_date
description: Date the policy or geography expires (Unix ms timestamp)
